cohort: The study included 75 patients with MIH and a control group, all aged between 6 to 28 years, recruited from a teaching dental hospital or a private dental practice in Bordeaux, France.
finding: Correlations were observed between hypoxia during delivery and the occurrence of MIH, and also between birth by caesarean section and MIH.
mod_finding: Birth by caesarean section was correlated with the occurrence of MIH (OR = 2.9; CI = 1.2-6.9).
